title: Shinonome Akito — I Won't Miss It Next Time〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: I Won't Miss It Next Time（2★）

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya.
It's rare of you to ask if we can have lunch up here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I apologize for springing that on you so suddenly, but I was looking for a place where we could talk privately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Talk privately...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: About An?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How did you know? I hadn't said anything yet.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It makes sense given the timing.
You just learned about what was going on with her yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. She told me about what she's been feeling, but I was hoping to hear your take on this situation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm kicking myself for not noticing what she was going through. I mean, we've been spending so much time together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't beat yourself up.
I only found out because I noticed she was acting a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not to mention, even when she's at the point of breaking, she always bounces back once one of us says something to her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, there was no way for us to know about this. There's no reason for you to be blaming yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But in that sense, you've sort of been helping keep her and the rest of this team afloat, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It seems like you've been the one facilitating Shiraishi's bounce-backs, Akito. You're always asking how she's doing during events and our usual practices.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I believe that you've been a massive pillar of support for her and the rest of our team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, we're friends, so I feel like it's normal for me to ask how she's doing if I see something's up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you're giving me more credit than I deserve. She always finds a way to pick herself back up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If she says, “I'm okay. I can do this,” then I'm going to believe her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and I'd expect nothing less from you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I felt something when I talked to all of you for my song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The idea of a “partner” has a special place in Shiraishi's heart.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She needs a partner in order to chase after her dream and make it come true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Like Ken and his team.
Partners you can always count on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does that mean you also spent a period of time searching for a good partner like Shiraishi did?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, kinda.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I wouldn't really call it a massive search. All I did was try talking to whoever I thought would be good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's how I ended up going around to all sorts of different events and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fortunately, I didn't have to spend much time looking. I ended up meeting you relatively fast.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And yet...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Without knowing any of that, I tried to distance myself from you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I honestly had no idea that you valued me so much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For that, you have my deepest apologies...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's all ancient history.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I don't care about that anymore.
Also, it works both ways, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember that time when...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine then, leave!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And never show your face around here again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I totally lost my cool and lashed out at you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's sort of why I took what you said at face value.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even though I knew that you weren't the type of person to walk all over someone's dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mentioned this a while back, but it took everything I had to keep up with you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why I didn't have the mental space to notice if there was anything going on with you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As your partner, I feel bad about not making that connection.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're standing here right now because we managed to get through all that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I eventually learned about what was really bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
Thank you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm not making the same mistake again...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm never losing sight of what my partner or teammates are feeling again.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If An's ever in a tight spot and runs out of options, then we're going to be there to help her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have to believe in our teammates and keep doing what we can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...!
